title: Towards Debiasing Sentence Representations
findings: The proposed method, SENT-DEBIAS, successfully reduces multiclass religious bias in sentence representations from both BERT and ELMo models. The paper demonstrates that by contextualizing bias-attribute words (e.g., torah, bible, quran) into diverse sentences, a bias subspace can be estimated and removed, leading to fairer representations while largely preserving performance on downstream NLP tasks.
